The agent explored the code, ran existing tests (which passed), then wrote a STATUS.json with low probabilities and gave up due to insufficient time. The verifier verdict is "fail", and there are many failing hidden tests.

We need to decide from the closed list: skill_gap, spec_defect, unstated_format, world_bug, verifier_defect, budget, env_flake, or abstain.

The agent gave up because of insufficient time. The trace shows the agent did some exploration but did not actually implement any changes to the code. The agent wrote STATUS.json with low probabilities and then said "Due to the extensive remaining work across all pending requirements, I cannot complete the implementation within the allowed tool calls." and "GIVE_UP: Insufficient time to fully implement all pending requirements". So the agent ran out of steps/tokens/time while still making progress? Actually the agent made some progress in understanding the code but did not implement any changes. The agent gave up due to budget (insufficient time). The failing tests are all hidden tests that likely test the requirements. Since the agent didn't implement anything, the tests fail.

But we need to check if the task was solvable as stated. The requirements seem clear and the codebase is a real library. The agent could have implemented the changes but didn't due to time constraints. So the cause is likely "budget" (the policy ran out of steps, tokens or time while still making progress). The agent explicitly said "Insufficient time to fully implement all pending requirements". So budget.

Also need to determine if the attempt actually satisfies every requirement (solution_correct). The agent didn't implement any changes, so solution_correct is false.

Evidence: quote the agent's final message: "Due to the extensive remaining work across all pending requirements, I cannot complete the implementation within the allowed tool calls.\n\nGIVE_UP: Insufficient time to fully implement all pending requirements"

Rationale: The agent gave up due to insufficient time/budget, not because of a spec defect or other issue.

Thus JSON: {"cause": "budget", "solution_correct": false, "evidence": "Due to the extensive remaining work across all pending requirements, I cannot complete the implementation within the allowed tool calls.\n\nGIVE_UP: Insufficient time to fully implement all pending requirements", "rationale": "The agent explicitly stated insufficient time to implement all requirements, indicating it ran out of budget."}
